title: Better Auth
description: The comprehensive TypeScript-first authentication framework for modern web frameworks with plugins for two-factor auth, passkeys, multi-tenancy, and admin roles.
features: Framework agnostic: works natively in Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Remix, and Express
Database agnostic with first-class Drizzle, Prisma, and Kysely adapters
Extensive official plugin ecosystem (Passkeys/WebAuthn, Two-Factor, Organization/Teams, Magic Links)
Built-in rate limiting and CSRF protection mechanisms
100% type-safe client with inference derived directly from server auth schema
pros: Solves the complexity and breaking changes of legacy NextAuth/Auth.js
Modularity: only pay the bundle size for the features and plugins you actually use
Comprehensive documentation and modern developer ergonomics
cons: Relatively young project with rapidly evolving minor release cycles
Requires configuring your own database tables and schema migrations
targetAudience: Modern TypeScript and Next.js developers needing robust, extensible self-hosted authentication.
